::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Noida-headquartered (IIT Kanpur outreach centre) with offices in Bengaluru and San Diego; founder and CEO Amiya Pathak (earlier built ZipDial). The company says its Gen 1 5G small-cell connectivity chip is in production and supplied with its L1 software and femto system; Gen 2, combining connectivity and perception on one die, has a tape-out plan in place, with samples to OEMs targeted for H2 2027.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Deterministic RISC-V/DSP compute and 5G small-cell connectivity chips, with a perception (edge-AI) SoC on the same architecture.
